care.summary: Stunning calathea with large, round, dark green leaves featuring a distinctive medallion-like pattern in silver and cream.
care.light: Bright indirect light; leaves burn in direct sun
care.water: Keep consistently moist; use distilled or rainwater
care.soil: Well-draining, peat-based potting mix rich in organic matter
care.fertilizer: Balanced houseplant fertilizer monthly in growing season
common_issues: Brown crispy leaf edges from low humidity or tap water
Pale leaves from too much light
tips: Must use distilled, filtered, or rainwater - tap water causes brown tips
Keep away from drafts and heating/cooling vents
Mist daily or use a humidifier
Wipe leaves gently with damp cloth monthly
